$Comment: Tomas's secret has two keys, and this factor reads 1 when the player holds either: his apprentice
quest done and collected (ziggfreedcommon:quest_completed, christmas_tomas_apprentice), which works on
every server, or Crafting level 20 (the factor Christmas_Tomas_Skill), which exists only where MMO Skill
Tree runs. The file name is the factor id. Formula adds the two and Clamp holds the sum at 1, so either
key alone opens the lock. Where MMO Skill Tree is missing the skill factor is absent and adds 0, so the
apprentice quest is the one key there.
Tomas's loaf recipe at his stall locks on this factor with Min 1
(ShopEntries/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Offer_Recipe_Tomas_Loaf.json). A player who holds neither key
reads the lock line its name overlays write, one for each kind of server: Christmas_Tomas_Key_Name.json
names only the quest, Mmo_Christmas_Tomas_Key_Name.json names the quest or the skill level.
